help.title: How to export clients from another system

altegio.title: From Altegio
altegio.step1: Open Altegio on a computer: Clients → Client Database.
altegio.step2: In the top right corner click Excel → Export to Excel.
altegio.step3: To export everyone, reset the filters first. You need the “Export client list to Excel” permission.
altegio.step4: Upload the downloaded file here — columns are matched automatically.

dikidi.title: From DIKIDI
dikidi.step1: Open DIKIDI Business on a computer and go to Clients.
dikidi.step2: Export the list to Excel with the export button above the list. If there's no button, ask DIKIDI support for an export.

sheet.title: From Excel, Google Sheets, Emly or Booker
sheet.step1: The first row holds column names: “Name” and “Phone”, optionally “Email”, “Date of birth”, “Comment”, “Categories”.
sheet.step2: Google Sheets: File → Download → Microsoft Excel (.xlsx). Or just select the rows, copy and paste them.
